# Std Deviation and Variance

![Std Deviation and Variance function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/statistics/03-std_variance.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Sample0 divides variance by n-1; Population1 by n. GS corrected skewness/kurtosis uses NIST G1/G2 (not NI-certified); kurtosis is Pearson normal3. Weighting 0 Sample (n-1), 1 Population (n).
